body:
Hello! Im a player from ocn, I have experience in tournaments, so I decided to make a team.

To apply, just leave your Skype down here.

Requirements:

- Have skype, mumble or ts
- Know Spanish or English
- Have good skills at pvp

We don't care about stats, so, if you have bad stats, don't worry, we will try you out.
